A review-question finding never joins the carry-forward at all (`dropReviewQuestionFindingsJSON`, keyed on `types.FindingCategoryReviewQuestion`, never the `question-` prefix): a question is resolved by its ANSWER and not by a coverage record, and every review turn re-emits every still-open question from the live conversation, so dropping it loses nothing.
